pages.text: Check Your Learning Identify each illustration as depicting a σ or π bond: (a) side-by-side overlap of a 4p and a 2p orbital (b) end-to-end overlap of a 4p and 4p orbital (c) end-to-end overlap of a 4p and a 2p orbital
Check Your Learning Repeat the calculation for HI, which has a dipole moment of 0.42 D and a bond length of 0.161 nm.
Check Your Learning What is the hybridization of the selenium atom in SeF4?
Check Your Learning Acetic acid, H3CC(O)OH, is the molecule that gives vinegar its odor and sour taste. What is the hybridization of the two carbon atoms in acetic acid?

Check Your Learning Another acid in acid rain is nitric acid, HNO3, which is produced by the reaction of nitrogen dioxide, NO2, with atmospheric water vapor. What is the hybridization of the nitrogen atom in NO2? (Note: the lone electron on nitrogen
occupies a hybridized orbital just as a lone pair would.)
Check Your Learning Label the molecular orbital shown as σ or π, bonding or antibonding and indicate where the node occurs.
Check Your Learning The main component of air is N2. From the molecular orbital diagram of N2, predict its bond order and whether it is diamagnetic or paramagnetic.
Check Your Learning How many unpaired electrons would be present on a ion? Would it be paramagnetic or diamagnetic?
